append.detail: 2026-11-09: re-checked read-only on Frequency Community. Grants still present (anon and authenticated hold INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE; RLS off; owner supabase_admin) and triggers sec007_rows and sec007_truncate are enabled, so writes are refused. The postgres role cannot revoke grants issued by supabase_admin, so the one step left is a Supabase support request run as supabase_admin. The plan, request text and check query are in docs/RUNBOOKS.md (PostGIS reference table). The SQL stays at scripts/ops/secure-postgis-reference-table.sql and is never a registered migration. Row stays open until the check query returns false, false, true.
